about: Rows found on the live lists of 2026-11-18, kept to hold the rule of fidsRowOffBoard (fids-current/js/feed-router.js). mia: records as Miami sends them through /miafids (the fields of worker-entry.js MIA_FIELDS), captured 14:34Z. served: rows of other airports as our worker served them between 14:32Z and 14:36Z (Toronto and Newark: as the adapters of the board made them from the records of the airport), trimmed to what the mappers read. off: why the row leaves (home, nowhere, no-terminal, callsign, unnamed, or list for the code list and name words), null when it stays. undecided: a row that stays because nothing in it says what it is. A row with one letter after its number leaves only as a second listing of a flight on the same list: the rows of one airport and direction are read together, as the list they came in.
